item.title: eval : a security catastrope in waiting
item.description: eval is one of Ruby’s most powerful methods. It’s also one of its most dangerous. When you use eval, you’re telling Ruby to treat a string as code and execute it. This opens the door to flexibility — but also to catastrophe.

item.title: What the Climate Change means for you and me
item.description:
Today is Earth day and an excellent opportunity to reflect on human’s environmental impact.

The pandemic hit countries like a truck and changed overnight our ways of working or interacting with others. Many lost their jobs, others went into depression or worse got infected with COVID-19.
